'''Gamma Five''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a member of [[Gamma Squad (Galactic Republic)|Gamma Squad]] and he accompanied the unit when it was sent to [[Mission to Cularin|infiltrate]] a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
